title: Interface loadObjectsOrInterfaces heap merge executor
description: Expected Foundry-compatible wire shape for loadObjectsOrInterfaces when the root ObjectSet is an interfaceBase spanning multiple implementing ObjectTypes. Pagination is heap-merged over per-type sub-cursors: the executor loads each implementing type concurrently, sorts its primary keys ASC, and the handler emits a composite MultiTypeCursor that tracks per-type offsets. Exhausted sub-cursors are dropped from the outgoing token.

pagination.comment: Per-type buckets are sorted ASC by primary key in the executor; the handler performs an iterative min-heap selection per page using per-type offsets decoded from the inbound MultiTypeCursor.

responseShape.nextPageToken: <base64 MultiTypeCursor or omitted on final page>

notes: A dedicated parity runner is not yet wired up; this fixture documents the expected shape for US-007 and will be consumed by test/foundry_parity/run.go once the Phase 6 Gate introduces it.
The aggregate handler still uses the flat Result.PrimaryKeys list on interfaceBase results so approximate aggregations over a polymorphic set keep working without knowing about per-type offsets.
Tie-break when two implementing types share a primary key value is stable: we pick the lexicographically smaller ObjectType API name.
